verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents V3 webhooks: users create webhook subscriptions to receive HTTP callbacks when significant account events occur, with event types for incident priority and responder changes plus filtering. This is a registrable outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on delivery guarantees, payload signing, and programmatic subscription management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP callbacks when significant events happen in your PagerDuty account
V3 webhooks are configured by creating a _webhook subscription_ which contains three main components
they provide additional event types to signal changes to incident priorities and incident responders. They also provide additional filtering capabilities.
